captions.story: Did you know there are actual lakes sitting at the bottom of the ocean? Dive into the mystery of brine pools.

story.series: What Lies Inside an Underwater Lake?
story.summary: This episode explored ocean brine pools—underwater lakes with high salinity, toxic gases, and preserved creatures. It highlighted the extremophile ecosystems on their shorelines and their potential implications for alien ocean worlds.

title: What Lies Inside an Underwater Lake?
